title: MADR with strict station-by-station calibration
intervention: Complete fresh exploration and the entire local calibration schedule for each station, permanently freeze its confirmed effective parameters, then continue downstream.
preserve_and_boundaries: Preserve each station local phases, candidate counts, diagnostics, knowledge, schema, acceptance, numerical constraints and recovery. Recursive upstream inputs remain physically frozen. Local NSE replaces unavailable global feedback; downstream exploration starts after upstream freezing. These are intrinsic workflow differences.
shared_execution: Shared hydrological executor, evaluation period, legal ranges and precision, phase locks except where explicitly ablated, same-background acceptance, center-reference reuse, retry/fallback policy, final confirmation and measured usage accounting remain active.
activation: Explicit ablations/run_ablation.py only; ordinary entry points remain unchanged.
frozen_upstream_diagnostics: Code diagnostics use each direct upstream station's finite successful terminal-confirmation NSE under its permanently frozen ancestor background, with the shared NSE < 0.5 quality rule. These records do not add active agents, change physical inputs, or create a global performance panel.
